138349 Ordinance 1202 LEGAL PUBLIC NOTICE City of Winlock  PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Winlock City Council adopted Ordinance No. 1202 on September 23, 2026. The intent and content of the ordinance are summarized as follows: CITY OF WINLOCK,  WASHINGTON  ORDINANCE NO. 1202  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WINLOCK, WASHINGTON, IMPOSING AN IMMEDIATE SIX-MONTH CITYWIDE MORATORIUM ON THE FILING, ACCEPTANCE, PROCESSING, REVIEW, AND APPROVAL OF APPLICATIONS TO ESTABLISH OR EXPAND DATA CENTERS; SETTING A PUBLIC HEARING; AND DECLARING AN EMERGENCY; PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY; AND ESTABLISHING AN EFFECTIVE DATE. Summary: Ordinance No. 1202 imposes an immediate six-month citywide moratorium on the filing, acceptance, processing, review, and approval of applications to establish or expand data centers within the City of Winlock. The ordinance defines data centers for purposes of the moratorium, directs City staff to conduct a Data Center Impact Review and Policy Framework, sets a public hearing for November 9, 2026, declares an emergency, and establishes the ordinance as effective immediately upon adoption. A complete copy of Ordinance No. 1202 is available for public inspection at the Office of the City Clerk, Winlock City Hall, 323 NE First Street, Winlock, Washington, during normal business hours. The full text of the ordinance will be mailed upon request. For additional information, contact City Hall at 360-785-3811. Published: The Chronicle September 29, 2026 - The Daily Chronicle
